name: portfolio-template
author: Bernd Krönker / Cabinet Gold van d’Vlies

scripts.hide: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const p = '.vscode/settings.json'; let s = {}; if (fs.existsSync(p)) { try { const cnt = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').trim(); if (cnt) s = JSON.parse(cnt); } catch(e) {} } s['files.exclude'] = s['files.exclude'] || s['_bak'] || { 'node_modules/': true, 'package-lock.json': true, 'package.json': true, 'eleventy.config.js': true, 'dist/': true, '.vscode/': true, 'src/projects/projects.json': true }; delete s['_bak']; if (!fs.existsSync('.vscode')) fs.mkdirSync('.vscode'); fs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(s, null, 2));"
scripts.unhide: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const p = '.vscode/settings.json'; let s = {}; if (fs.existsSync(p)) { try { const cnt = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').trim(); if (cnt) s = JSON.parse(cnt); } catch(e) {} } if (s['files.exclude']) { s['_bak'] = s['files.exclude']; delete s['files.exclude']; } if (!fs.existsSync('.vscode')) fs.mkdirSync('.vscode'); fs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(s, null, 2));"
scripts.dev: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const p = '.vscode/settings.json'; if (fs.existsSync(p)) { try { const s = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8')); if (s['files.exclude']) { s['files.exclude']['dist/'] = true; fs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(s, null, 2)); } } catch(e){} }" && eleventy --serve
scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const p = '.vscode/settings.json'; if (fs.existsSync(p)) { try { const s = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8')); if (s['files.exclude']) { s['files.exclude']['dist/'] = false; fs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(s, null, 2)); } } catch(e){} }" && eleventy
scripts.preview: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const p = '.vscode/settings.json'; if (fs.existsSync(p)) { try { const s = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8')); if (s['files.exclude']) { s['files.exclude']['dist/'] = false; fs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(s, null, 2)); } } catch(e){} }" && npm run build && serve dist
